description: This file defines a static class StringEncodedWriteVector with methods to manipulate a string-based bitvector representing replica sets for event sourcing. It includes functions to get the state of a particular replica's bit and to toggle that bit.

classes.name: StringEncodedWriteVector
classes.description: A static utility class providing methods to handle string-encoded replica bitvectors for event sourcing replication.

methods.name: GetBit
methods.description: Returns whether the bit for a specified replica in the write vector string is set to 1.

methods.name: FlipBit
methods.description: Toggles the bit for a specified replica in the write vector string and returns the new bit state.
